origin.note: The walk added the size beside an existing page count; the fixture has none, so this case asks for both.

title: Show the file size next to the page count
objective: On the document page's meta line (data-testid="doc-meta"), show the page count and the file size, like "18 pages · 2.4 MB". Sizes under 1 MB show whole KB ("48 KB"); 1 MB and over show MB with one decimal. 1 KB is 1000 bytes.
plan_summary: Add formatBytes to format.mjs; render pages and size joined by a middle dot in documentPage.
